# System Maturity — frontend plugin

Frontend for the **System Maturity** Backstage plugin: a maturity tab on the catalog **Entity Page** via `EntitySystemMaturityContent`.

**npm package:** `@vtex-lab-ufpe/backstage-plugin-system-maturity`  
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@vtex-lab-ufpe/backstage-plugin-system-maturity.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vtex-lab-ufpe/backstage-plugin-system-maturity)

## Installation

```bash
yarn workspace app add @vtex-lab-ufpe/backstage-plugin-system-maturity
```

In `packages/app/src/components/catalog/EntityPage.tsx`, import and add a route to `EntityLayout`:

```tsx
import { EntitySystemMaturityContent } from '@vtex-lab-ufpe/backstage-plugin-system-maturity';

<EntityLayout.Route path="/system-maturity" title="System Maturity">
  <EntitySystemMaturityContent />
</EntityLayout.Route>
```

## Public API

- `systemMaturityPlugin`
- `EntitySystemMaturityContent`

## Documentation

- [Integrating into another Backstage app](./docs/integration-with-dk-portal-main.md)

## Development

- Full monorepo: `yarn start` from the root.
- Plugin in isolation (faster iteration): `yarn start` in this directory; see [`dev/`](./dev).
